free_tier.stated: no free tier: one Runner is USD 299 per month with unlimited simulator time; the Argent toolkit itself has a free open-source offer, but the Cloud hardware rental has no published free minutes or credit

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a reserved Mac with iOS Simulators, not an object

retention.stated: not published on the page read: no retention period for simulator state is stated

egress.terms: not published on the page read: no egress allowance or price is stated

interface_detail: a pool of network-accessible iOS Simulators reached over the network; Argent, Maestro, Appium, custom scripts and CI pipelines can connect; no published API, CLI or port list
tooling: Argent, Maestro, Appium or custom scripts that connect to a remote Simulator; the app itself is built on a machine the customer supplies, because Argent Cloud supplies only Simulators, not a Mac to build on
chaining: this is a partial compute offer: it sells Simulators on dedicated Apple hardware but no Mac to build the app and no machine for the agent, both of which must come from another record. A hosted service, not self-hosted software. Free credits are not published, so a paid Runner is the entry point.

limits.value: one Runner is up to 6 parallel iOS Simulators on a Mac reserved for one project for the whole month; self-serve checkout covers at most 4 Runners and a larger fleet needs sales

limits_note: unlimited simulator time on the reserved Runner; the constraint is the number of Runners and the 6 parallel Simulators per Runner, plus activation that may take up to 2 business days.
binding_note: the per-Runner capacity of 6 parallel Simulators and the 4-Runner self-serve checkout ceiling bind first; no free minutes exist, so the first paid month is required.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the checkout form shows a checkout email and the docs say one API key is issued per user and sent directly; the terms charge a payment method through a payment processor (Lemon Squeezy) but name no card, and further registration fields are behind a sign-up that was not entered

reliability_note: activation may take up to 2 business days (48 hours) after payment because of demand; the service is built and operated by an ISO/IEC 27001 certified company and reports complete isolation between customers.
confidence_note: price, capacity, unlimited time and checkout fields are quoted from the vendor's own cloud pricing and cloud pages read on 2026-11-25; the simulator-only scope and activation time are quoted from the vendor's FAQ.
